description: This file defines the POSInvoiceMergeLog class and related functions for managing the merging and unmerging of POS invoices, including background job handling, validation, and processing logic within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: POSInvoiceMergeLog
classes.description: Class representing a log for merging POS invoices, including validation, submission, cancellation, and merging logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the POS invoice merge log, including customer and invoice status checks.

methods.name: validate_customer
methods.description: Checks if all invoices are against the same customer or customer group.

methods.name: validate_pos_invoice_status
methods.description: Ensures each POS invoice is submitted, not consolidated, and return invoices are properly linked.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles logic when the merge log is submitted, including creating consolidated invoices.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic when the merge log is canceled, including updating linked invoices.

methods.name: process_merging_into_sales_invoice
methods.description: Creates and merges POS invoices into a new sales invoice.

methods.name: process_merging_into_credit_note
methods.description: Creates and merges POS invoices into a new credit note.

methods.name: merge_pos_invoice_into
methods.description: Merges multiple POS invoices into a single invoice object, aggregating items, taxes, and payments.

methods.name: get_new_sales_invoice
methods.description: Creates a new sales invoice document with customer info.

methods.name: update_pos_invoices
methods.description: Updates POS invoices with references to consolidated invoices or credit notes.

methods.name: cancel_linked_invoices
methods.description: Cancels the consolidated sales invoices or credit notes linked to the merge log.
